versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the 1panel-install skill for one-click installation of the 1Panel server management panel.
- Automatically detects existing installations and returns panel access info if 1Panel is already installed.
- Runs full installation process with dependency and root permission checks if 1Panel is not present.
- Provides clear natural language feedback after installation, including access address, username, and password.
- Includes detailed error handling and troubleshooting guidance for common installation issues.
